title: Employee Benefits Quality Consultant
location_text: Hartford, CT; Alpharetta,GA-NPointPkwy-Maxum; Lake Mary - Colonial Center Pkwy; United States - Remote
description:
Consultant Quality - QU08AE
We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.
The Quality Management team provides governance and oversight validating adherence to pricing protocols, underwriting standards, documentation protocols and guidelines across all of Employment Benefits operating segments (this role is specific to Regional/National Accounts).
The Underwriting Quality Consultant is expected to build relationships and collaborate with cross functional business customers, at various levels of the organization, to successfully drive Quality results and inform Risk Management.
Responsibilities:
Execute quality reviews by reconstructing Employee Benefits underwriting cases to validate adherence to compliance and regulatory standards, pricing protocols, underwriting standards, documentation protocols and guidelines.
Perform targeted audits on emerging trends, areas of concern or process changes to inform Risk Management practices and guidelines.
Complete root cause analysis on quality reviews and audit results by evaluating data for quality trends and opportunities from multiple sources including, but not limited to independently run reports.
Deliver meaningful feedback in a respectable manner to Underwriters and or their leaders when reporting Quality results, trends, and recommendations.
Support Strategic Reserve by underwriting cases during peak periods; collaborate effectively with business customers (Underwriting & Sales) to meet customer deadlines.
Identify learning opportunities based on quality findings: prepare and present training materials when applicable.
Lead or participate in strategic initiatives exhibiting thought leadership by providing insightful input and expertise to influence and deliver optimal business outcomes.
Function as an Underwriting Subject Matter Expert: stay current with guideline, best practice, tool and system enhancements. Competently articulate enhancements to Underwriters to ensure consistency across the organization when deviations are identified.
Effectively coach and mentor Underwriters, provide insightful and comprehensive consultations, tailor conversations based on individual needs to instill expertise among our Underwriting organization.
Manage own time and workload efficiently: balance multiple priorities to fulfill all commitments within established timeframes.
Qualifications:
Technical underwriting knowledge, ability to underwrite Employee Benefit cases with limited complexity
3+ years of Employee Benefits underwriting experience required; National Accounts (5,000+) and Regional Accounts (1,000 – 4,999) experience strongly preferred
Must be detail oriented; able to challenge existing norms using logic
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Solid understanding of quality evaluation processes/principles
Proven ability to act with integrity and respect (understands nature of work is confidential and will act accordingly)
Self-starter with the ability to work across all levels and areas within the organization
Contribute to the customer’s success by troubleshooting issues, researching and providing recommendations that streamline workflows.
Ability to work independently to drive results
Ability to multi-task while demonstrating the ability to prioritize and manage time effectively
Excellent organizational skills
Strong team building and interpersonal skills
Strong working knowledge of Microsoft office
This role will have a Hybrid or Remote work schedule. Candidates who live near one of our office locations (Hartford, CT; Lake Mary, FL; Alpharetta, GA) will have the expectation of working in an office 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday). Candidates who do not live near an office will have a remote work schedule, with the expectation of coming into an office as business needs arise.
Compensation
The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short-term or annual bonuses, long-term incentives, and on-the-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is:
$66,800 - $100,200
